_: Family Edition Phase D -- kitchen members, self-publishing, attribution. Every assertion is broken on purpose in a COPY of the folder that carries it (the Kitchen service, the family sign-in, GutLog). The five the brief names: draftinpool (a draft visible in the pool before its contributor publishes), anyedit (another member able to edit someone's recipe), noattrib + noattriblog (attribution missing from a card / a logged meal), kreach (a kitchen member reaching /m1/ and the health endpoints), healthcol (a health field in the Kitchen schema).
